title: Romania's Twin Crisis: Political Paralysis and Economic Strain Test Public… · 10 Sep
keywords: Romania, government formation, coalition talks, political stalemate, GDP contraction, inflation, Eurostat, EU funds, fiscal consolidation, National Recovery and Resilience Plan, European Union, Bucharest, budget deficit, household incomes, Eastern Europe
notes: Romania is grappling with a prolonged government formation stalemate that is freezing key fiscal and reform decisions, while its economy contracts and inflation remains the highest in the European Union. The combination of institutional deadlock and household financial pressure is fuelling a mood of resignation among citizens. For Brussels, the situation raises questions about a large member state's ability to deliver on its EU commitments.
